acceptanceCriteria: Same-window baseline is measured and compared in the verdict.
Linux /proc/loadavg path exercised live with retained output.
Live run under synthetic CPU load yields LATENCY_HOST_CONTENDED; GH #1406 closed.
body: V1-2192 (PR #1413, AHI-171) records load/CPU/run-queue per timing window and returns RETRY_LATER LATENCY_HOST_CONTENDED. Remaining from GH #1406: a same-window baseline measurement, a live Linux /proc/loadavg reading, and a live run under synthetic CPU load. PR uses Refs #1406, not Closes.
title: opencode qualification: same-window latency baseline and Linux /proc/loadavg reading (GH #1406 remainder)
